result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: Customer receives a 30-day written-notice convenience right, a refund of prepaid fees attributable to the post-termination period, and no early-termination charge, while Vendor has no convenience right during an Order Form term. It preserves the existing cause-based and Order Form-specific termination provisions. However, allowing termination “in whole or in part” adds a partial-scope termination right not required by the playbook, so the change is not strictly minimal. The provision is otherwise professionally drafted, though it should be assigned a subsection number and the Section 10.2 cross-reference should be confirmed not to qualify the refund.
